title: Must See Monday – Event of the Week
content:
What: Enchanted Xmas Garden // Where: Westonbirt Arboretum // When: 28th Nov – 12 Dec   (5-8.30pm) // Cost: £10/£8 conc./£5 children

If you go down in the woods today your sure of a big surprise.

Once again this Christmas Westonbirt Arboretum opens it doors at night to all for its Enchanted Christmas spectacular.

Featuring a unforgettable one mile illuminated trail, highlighting the striking structures of Westonbirt’s trees as they are illuminated against the winter night sky this is expected to be a true visual treat.

Each year a new lighting design is created so visitors can experience different specimens, paths and vistas in the tree collection. The route is on hard paths so it’s fully accessible for mobility scooters.

Due to its location in the Old Arboretum, unfortunately dogs are not permitted.
